app.name: Freelance Command Center
app.tagline: Jobs, messages and notifications from all your freelance platforms in one place.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. New jobs from your platforms appear here within a few minutes.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your e-mail address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.success: Your password has been changed and you have been signed out on all devices.
resetPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

account.unverified: Your e-mail address is not confirmed yet. Connecting platforms requires a confirmed address.
account.resent: A new confirmation link has been sent.

identity.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
identity.weak_password: The password must be 10 to 128 characters long.
identity.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
identity.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

network.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.

pagination.invalid_cursor: This list has changed. Reload the page.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

matching.too_many_keywords: You can add up to 20 keywords.

notification.invalid_push_token: This device cannot receive notifications. Restart the app and try again.

jobAlerts.title: Job alerts
jobAlerts.intro: Get a notification when a new job matches your keywords: its title, description or skills contain one of them as a whole word or phrase.
jobAlerts.mobileHint: Notifications arrive in the mobile app. Turn them on there under Settings.
jobAlerts.noKeywords: Add at least one keyword; without keywords you get no notifications.
jobAlerts.pushOn: Notifications on this phone are on.
jobAlerts.pushOff: Notifications on this phone are off.
jobAlerts.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this app in the phone settings.
jobAlerts.pushUnsupported: This app cannot receive notifications here: they need the installed app on a real phone, not Expo Go.

platformMail.title: Platform e-mails
platformMail.intro: Fiverr, Bionluk and Arc.dev have no API for jobs and messages, so they reach your inbox through their notification e-mails. Forward those e-mails to your personal address below.

steps.rule: In your mailbox (Gmail, Outlook, ...), create a forwarding rule to this address.
steps.senders: Limit the rule to mail from fiverr.com, bionluk.com and arc.dev, so no other mail leaves your mailbox.
steps.check: Forwarded e-mails appear in the list below within a few seconds.

platformMail.renewHint: Anyone who knows this address can send mail into your inbox. If it has leaked, replace it and update your forwarding rule; mail to the old address is dropped.
